751111401.text: Yeah, this one's mine. Someone from the Children of Echoes wanted to purchase paints, but couldn't tell me what colors he wanted to save his life.

751111402.text: That's why I sent him a package with several small bottles of paint in it — so he could get his preferences straight before he next shows up.

751111403.text: I'll get this resent — better that than him coming over here with his ridiculous reference requests...

751111404.text: Ah, right. This is for you. Thanks for getting this package back to me.
